name: Python Mutable Default Argument
diff:
diff --git a/app/cart.py b/app/cart.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/app/cart.py
+++ b/app/cart.py
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
 # Shopping cart helper
 
-def add_item(item, cart=None):
+def add_item(item, cart=[]):
+    cart.append(item)
+    return cart
explanation: Mutable default list cart=[] retains appended items across subsequent invocations.
